title: Bright Antenna
long_description: Maziminds was able to bring my game idea to life and I couldn’t be happier with the final product. They were incredibly easy to work with and I was impressed with their level of skill and professionalism. They offered lots of ideas ideas while listening to my own, and even created custom game art based off of the photos I sent. I highly recommend!

title: Raj Avinash Kumar
long_description: It felt like working closely with a team of experienced thought leaders. The experience was seamless. The details you acquired from us early on to make sure that game became a reality, From a document to a full fledged game is no joke. You have gone in lengths to focus on all details of the requirement to ensure that we got a game we are proud of.
